title: Concept: Dependency declared with a strict open bound
description: package.json declares a `>` specifier that excludes the named version and every version above it, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration accepts an unbounded set of future releases and cannot be satisfied by the version the manifest names, so review and install disagree.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration accepts an unbounded set of future releases and cannot be satisfied by the version the manifest names, so review and install disagree.
